description: Resource files. create makes a .tres of any engine resource class, a Material class for a material. read answers in the form modify takes. A Theme item is a property named like `Button/colors/font_color`. move and read need no editor. A modify drops the lines read lists under notLoaded. move with no editor writes .uid and .import files, and leaves paths in .scn and .res files (leftAlone). A relative path stays as written in text, tooltip_text, placeholder_text, resource_name, node names, groups, ; comment lines and .import files. A GDScript comment stays whole. Headless, it updates .godot's class list and starts autoloads. Operations: read: the properties a resource file sets; create (needs resourceType); modify: set or unset properties on an existing resource; create_shader (needs shaderType): a .gdshader file; create_tileset (needs sources): a TileSet from texture atlases, whose layers and tile data modify writes after it; set_theme_color (needs controlType, colorName, color): a colour in a Theme; set_theme_font_size (needs controlType, fontSizeName, size): a font size in a Theme; remove_theme_item (needs controlType): take one item, or every item of a type, out of a Theme; move (needs newPath): move or rename a file or a directory, and the paths in the project naming it.

code.description: The shader source, written as given. Default: a minimal shader of that type. For op create_shader.

color.description: r, g and b from 0 to 1 with a optional, or an html code such as "#ff8000". For op set_theme_color.

controlType.description: The theme type, a Control or Window class such as "Button", or the name of a type variation. A name that is no class is set as a variation. For ops set_theme_color, set_theme_font_size, remove_theme_item.

includeDefaults.description: Include properties still at their default. Default false. For op read.

item.description: The item to take out, such as `colors/font_color`. Without it, every item of controlType goes, with its base_type when it is a variation. For op remove_theme_item.

newPath.description: Where it goes, inside the project. A file goes with its .import and .uid, and paths naming it are rewritten. For op move.

preview.description: Answer with what would move and change, and write nothing. Default false. For op move.

properties.description: Properties to set, keyed by Godot name, in the forms scene_node properties takes. For ops create, modify.

resourcePath.description: File inside the project, such as "sprites/hero.png" or "materials/steel.tres". move: a directory too. read: also a resource inside a scene file, such as "res://hero.tscn::Animation_jump".

resourceType.description: The resource class, such as "PhysicsMaterial", or a declared class_name. For op create.

script.description: A script to attach. For op create.

shaderType.description: The shader_type line. For op create_shader.

size.description: Pixels, a whole number of 1 or more. For op set_theme_font_size.

sources.description: Atlas sources, one per texture. A resourcePath that already exists is refused. For op create_tileset.

texture.description: A texture file inside the project, such as "sprites/tiles.png".

unset.description: Properties to remove from the file, keyed as in properties, such as "shader_parameter/tint". An editor's next save writes an unset shader parameter back. For op modify.

name: resource_edit
title: Edit resources
